# Polymux

> Polymux is a desktop AI workspace that brings chats, email, files, an encrypted Vault, connected devices, browser tabs, and a user's choice of AI models together in one place.

Polymux runs on macOS, Windows, and Linux. It lets a user ask one assistant to find and work with the right conversation, file, or browser page while keeping the workspace and model choice together. Connected devices can run Assistant work on a paired computer, and the encrypted Vault stores passwords, authenticator codes, recovery codes, and passkeys. Browser-extension access is limited to tab metadata and the exact tab assigned to a task.

## Product facts

- Product name: Polymux
- Category: Desktop AI workspace
- Platforms: macOS, Windows, Linux
- Current app version: 0.3.1
- Current release notes: 0.3.1
- Core surfaces: Chat, Hub, Drive, Browser, Vault, Tasks, Mobile
- Connected devices can run Assistant work on the current computer or a paired Host.
- The encrypted Vault stores passwords, authenticator codes, recovery codes, and passkeys with optional account sync of the encrypted vault only.
- Connected services include messaging, email, cloud drives, local files, hosted AI providers, and local models.
